01 / A little about me

PhD studies are my home base. The questions are bigger than any one discipline.

I'm Gal Goldstein, an AI PhD student interested in how intelligent systems can help people understand, create, and do more.

I hold an M.Sc. from the University of Haifa, where I studied in the AMEL Lab with Makovsky. I’m now pursuing doctoral study in artificial intelligence, building depth across the ideas, methods, and systems shaping the field.

My research interests are taking shape around AI, human needs, and meaningful real-world problems. I’m drawn to work that connects careful investigation with ideas people can actually use.
